title: Paeoniflorin Attenuates the Progression of Diabetic Kidney Disease by Regulating Macrophage Differentiation.
authors: Shi, Chunru; Li, Run; Deng, Lingchen; Pan, Dan; Fu, Zhangning; He, Guosen; Qu, Yilun; Liu, Ran; Wang, Xu; Chen, Xiangmei; Hong, Quan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药苷通过HIF-1α调控巨噬细胞极化改善糖尿病肾病，属纯药理学与疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Paeoniflorin (PF), a bioactive compound from Paeonia lactiflora, exhibits anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. Macrophage-driven inflammation is a key contributor to diabetic kidney disease (DKD). This study aimed to determine whether PF mitigates DKD by regulating macrophage polarization. The db/db mice were treated orally with PF (50 or 100 mg/kg/day) for 10 weeks. Renal function, histopathology, and macrophage infiltration were assessed. In vitro, RAW264.7 macrophages were exposed to high glucose. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA), and HIF-1alpha siRNA knockdown were used to investigate mechanistic targets. PF improved renal function, reduced albuminuria, and attenuated glomerular injury. It decreased CD68(+) macrophage infiltration and inhibited M1 polarization, lowering TNF-alpha and iNOS expression. PF directly bound and stabilized HIF-1alpha, while HIF-1alpha knockdown abolished PF's anti-inflammatory effects. PF reduced HIF-1alpha protein expression without affecting mRNA expression, indicating post-transcriptional regulation. PF protects against DKD by inhibiting HIF-1alpha-mediated M1 macrophage polarization, revealing a novel mechanism to modulate macrophage-driven renal inflammation and supporting PF as a potential therapeutic agent for DKD.
abstract_zh: 芍药苷（PF）是源自芍药（Paeonia lactiflora）的一种生物活性化合物，具有抗炎和免疫调节作用。巨噬细胞驱动的炎症是糖尿病肾病（DKD）的关键诱因。本研究旨在确定PF是否通过调节巨噬细胞极化来缓解DKD。db/db小鼠口服PF（50或100 mg/kg/天）治疗10周，评估肾功能、组织病理学和巨噬细胞浸润。体外实验中，RAW264.7巨噬细胞暴露于高糖环境。采用网络药理学、分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和HIF-1alpha siRNA敲低技术研究机制靶点。PF改善了肾功能、减少了白蛋白尿并减轻了肾小球损伤。它降低了CD68(+)巨噬细胞浸润并抑制M1极化，降低了TNF-alpha和iNOS表达。PF直接结合并稳定HIF-1alpha，而HIF-1alpha敲低则消除了PF的抗炎作用。PF降低了HIF-1alpha蛋白表达而不影响mRNA表达，表明存在转录后调控。PF通过抑制HIF-1alpha介导的M1巨噬细胞极化来保护DKD，揭示了一种调节巨噬细胞驱动肾脏炎症的新机制，并支持PF作为DKD的潜在治疗药物。
